note: Official pages only, checked live. Amounts and windows change every cycle: always confirm on the official site.

items.name: CHED Tulong Dunong Program (TDP)
items.coverage: Grant-in-aid per semester (amount per current guidelines)
items.eligibility: Financially needy students in CHED-recognized HEIs; via CHED regional offices.

items.name: Tertiary Education Subsidy (TES)
items.eligibility: Students in SUCs/LUCs/private HEIs; priority to Listahanan/4Ps households.

items.name: DOST-SEI Undergraduate Scholarships (RA 7687 / Merit / RA 10612)
items.fields: Science, technology, engineering, math, science teaching
items.deadline: Check official site (exam usually announced mid-year)
items.eligibility: Incoming college freshmen in priority S&T courses; national exam.

items.name: DOST-SEI Graduate Scholarships (ASTHRDP / ERDT)
items.eligibility: Graduate students in accredited PH universities in S&T fields.

items.name: GSIS Scholarship Program (GSP)
items.eligibility: Dependents of active GSIS members within salary grade limits.

items.name: SSS Educational Assistance Loan Program
items.eligibility: SSS members for themselves or a beneficiary; loan terms apply.

items.name: SM College Scholarship
items.eligibility: Incoming freshmen from low-income families with good grades.

items.name: Ayala Foundation scholarships / youth programs
items.eligibility: Check current program calls.

items.name: Megaworld Foundation Scholarship
items.eligibility: Academically excellent, financially challenged students in partner schools.

items.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
items.eligibility: Bachelor's degree; apply directly to each consortium.

items.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
items.provider: Government of Japan (via Embassy in PH)
items.deadline: Check official site (embassy recommendation usually Apr–May)
items.eligibility: Age limits by category; embassy exam/interview.

items.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
items.eligibility: Eligible ASEAN countries incl. PH; return home after.

items.name: DAAD Scholarships (incl. EPOS)
items.eligibility: Programs vary; DAAD scholarship database.

items.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
items.eligibility: Work + leadership experience; eligible country list.

items.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
items.eligibility: PH is a partner country; nominated via sending partner.

items.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
items.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
items.eligibility: Check eligible countries (Commonwealth members); PH is NOT a Commonwealth member, so only shared/distance schemes may apply.

items.name: Türkiye Bursları (Türkiye Scholarships)
items.coverage: Tuition, stipend, housing, flights, Turkish course
items.eligibility: Age and grade limits by level.

items.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
items.deadline: Check official site (French universities nominate, usually by Jan)
items.eligibility: Nominated by a French institution.

items.name: Orange Knowledge Programme / Netherlands scholarships
items.deadline: Check official site (OKP has ended; see Study in NL for current schemes)
items.eligibility: Check Study in NL for current scholarships.

items.name: ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship (Singapore)
items.eligibility: ASEAN nationals admitted to Singapore autonomous universities.

items.name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship
items.eligibility: Foreign nationals incl. ASEAN; via MFA Brunei / embassy.

items.name: OWWA Education for Development Scholarship Program (EDSP)
items.coverage: Up to ₱60,000 per school year (per OWWA)
items.eligibility: Dependents of active OWWA members; qualifying exam.

items.name: OWWA ELAP (Education and Livelihood Assistance Program)
items.coverage: Education assistance for dependents of deceased OFWs
items.eligibility: Children of deceased OWWA-member OFWs.

items.name: Chevening Scholarships
items.eligibility: 2+ years work experience; return home for 2 years after.

items.name: Fulbright Philippines (Graduate Student / Scholar)
items.eligibility: Filipino citizens; returning-home requirement.

items.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS, formerly KGSP)
items.coverage: Full: tuition, stipend, airfare, Korean language year
items.deadline: Check official site (graduate track often Feb–Mar)
items.eligibility: Via embassy or university track.
